reason: Stacked on #1043 (follow-up queue and model choices), rebased on main 936b5d5 after #1038; the selection is the union of both PRs because this diff against main includes #1043. Fixes a terminal client bug and adds GUI goal, approval and subagent controls. /goal complete always failed with 'Core (422): completion requires a summary and evidence' because the TUI sent the running goal's empty completion_evidence; Core's validation is correct and the GUI is unaffected (it requires summary and evidence before enabling Confirm). The TUI now asks for evidence items and sends them as operator_confirmation, and retries a goal action once on a moved revision. Adds /goal child and child-goal listing; subagent approvals, edited arguments and SSH always-allow in /approvals; subagent status, open, stop and stop-all in /agents; and opens subagent and child-goal conversations. Selected: the new agents unit contracts, the shell suite (approval rows), a real paired TLS LAN Core PTY journey (child goal and completion with evidence), the product-knowledge search and Chroma digest sync, the settings-catalog terminal test, and the remembered-chat real-Core case for the open_view change.
exclusions: No full suites. No native or Playwright changes: only the separate Python terminal client, docs and settings catalog keywords changed; browser viewport projects do not exercise these terminal workflows and the catalog change is covered by its Vitest file. Existing approval and goal real-Core cases (test_terminal_queue_detach_approval_and_ctrl_c_use_core_state, test_paired_terminal_direct_chats_skills_goal_attachments_and_reconnect) fail identically on pristine origin/main (an un-awaited store.get in the first), so they cannot prove this change; tests/test_terminal_pty.py does not touch these workflows. Subagent and SSH approval journeys need a delegating model or SSH host the inert fixture lacks; they are covered by MockTransport unit cases. test_paired_full_screen_tui_shows_progress_and_saved_answer is not selected: its raw 'YOU · SENDING' expect is racy on pristine main. No live provider calls or Core deployment.
